# Docker images the integration tests pin. The tests read floci/floci from here
# (flociaws/images_test.go) and CI pulls every line, so the tag is declared once.
# One image:tag per line; '#' comments and blank lines are ignored. The library
# default stays floci/floci:latest; the examples use it too, as user-facing code.
floci/floci:2.2.0
